outcome_statement: Give a host application a tenant-scoped, high-density operational grid without copying the donor application into the host.

admission_scope.interpretation: An empty tenant/application scope means admitted nowhere; synthetic fixture status is a test boundary, not an admission.

data_isolation.database: Historical database-layer candidate evidence only; independent current host role/schema/restore proof remains held in records/qualification.json.
data_isolation.cache_namespace: Historical Redis ACL/prefix evidence only; no current donor-bound isolation replay by this package.
data_isolation.object_storage: Not proven: authenticated attachment upload/read and namespace isolation remain blocked.

framing_debt.justification: Teable owns its HTTP, realtime, metadata and per-base data runtime; absorbing it natively would mean vendoring an AGPL application whose Section 7 corresponding-source obligation is unresolved. The host-proxy sidecar mount preserves the donor runtime while keeping the host in control of identity, tenancy and URL space. Note records/packaging.json describes the donor as a cross-origin/intact service for token purposes: the theme bridge below is host-authored CSS scoped to the host-rendered surface, NOT inherited donor variables.
framing_debt.absorption_path: Close the AGPL Section 7 corresponding-source attestation, then absorb the grid rendering layer natively behind the existing ports (grid-query.v1, grid-mutate.v1) while leaving the donor data plane a sidecar; the ports are already the seam that would survive that change.

donor.source_digest_basis: git archive tar stream at immutable revision
donor.license: AGPL-3.0 with Teable Section 7 brand-protection terms; packages retain their own notices

ownership.donor_runtime: Teable sidecar owns its HTTP, realtime, metadata and per-base data runtime
ownership.host_binding: Actionist host owns the verified identity context, outer URL, tenant selection, navigation, settings entry, policy and observability envelope
ownership.host_data: Host-owned tables remain outside Teable resources and are never claimed by Teable migrations
ownership.migration_rule: Exactly one migration owner per resource; no shared-table migration history

configuration.secret_policy: Only environment references are persisted; no credential value is written into this package.

fixture.purpose: Synthetic manifest validation and binding generation only; it contains no client data and performs no network or donor-source action.

holds.statement: Authenticated native desktop and mobile UI CRUD are recorded BLOCKED in the exact historical receipt.
holds.next_gate: fresh reproducible authenticated proof session covering both surfaces

holds.statement: Attachment upload/read authorization and tenant/base namespace proof are blocked; a signed URL is not host authorization.
holds.next_gate: authenticated upload, read-authorization and cross-tenant denial for a namespaced object

holds.statement: Independent per-client role/schema and independent restore boundary do not close in the isolation gate.
holds.next_gate: exact-pin run proving least-privilege role/schema, Redis namespace, attachment namespace, backup/restore and second-client denial together

holds.statement: The host identity/session handoff and direct-denial proof are not reproduced in this package.
AGPL corresponding-source and Section 7 product/legal attestation gate remains blocked.
